course.title: Housing and Real Estate Development Theory
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose, a person in Greenland slum earns a family income of 14000 BDT. They have two 2 school going children. They have an outstanding loan of 120,000 BDT with a monthly installment of 1500 BDT. In reference to the current Bangladesh's National Housing Policy, 2016, explain how that person can acquire a formal housing. Highlight both the short and long term household strategy.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
